newsitem.title: USA: Houston Exploration completing natgas well.
newsitem.headline: Houston Exploration completing natgas well.

text.p: Houston Exploration Co said the Matagorda Island 651 A-5 well, in the Gulf of Mexico offshore Texas, is being completed as a natural gas producer.

Expected production of 7.5 million cubic feet daily is expected this month. Houston Exploration has a 79.6 percent working interest in Matagorda Island 651, while 18 percent is held or represented by Enserch Exploration Inc.

The well was started Sept 14 and was drilled to a depth of 11,610 feet. It encountered 200 feet of net pay in four separate sand sections between 10,600 feet and 11,200 feet. Two sands were tested and had initial flow rates of 9.4 and 3.4 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
Houston Exploration also said the Asche No. 28 was drilled to 10,408 feet in the South Texas Charco field and encountered 70 feet of gas pay in the Perdido sand section.
Production is expected to begin during January at a rate of about 5.0 million cubic feet daily. Houston Exploration owns a 95 percent working interest in the well and field.
